title: Segmented release note playbook and stakeholder readiness checklist
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Create a reusable playbook and templated artifacts to produce segmented release notes (enterprise, self-serve, developer docs, and internal engineering runbook) and coordinate stakeholder readiness for launches. Deliverables: 1) A one-page Playbook describing roles, signoff gates, and timelines; 2) Segmented changelog templates (customer-facing short-form, technical changelog for engineers, and an executive summary for account teams); 3) A checklist-based readiness tracker for Marketing/Sales/Support/Docs/Legal; 4) A small automation script (GitHub Actions) that assembles release assets from a single source-of-truth draft and opens required PRs/threads. Acceptance criteria: - Stakeholder owners identified and committed (Marketing, Sales, Support, Docs, Legal, Security, Engineering) - Templates reviewed and approved by Docs and Legal - Playbook validated in one internal release dry-run by 2025-11-28 - Automation assembles artifacts into /releases/console-2025.11 and creates draft PR with populated changelog. Out-of-scope: full localization; that will be handled in a follow-up task. Risks/notes: enterprise customers need a more detailed rollout message and redaction process for security-sensitive change descriptions; coordinate with Privacy team early. This ticket is intended to standardize process and reduce last-minute review churn across PMs and Eng leads.
